title: Parley Notes for
estate agents
estate.subtitle: Record thirty seconds after the viewing. Parley writes the feedback, with the prices and the agreements in it.

sections.heading: Six viewings, and the feedback at nine in the evening.
lede: The seller wants an answer the same day.
The brief shifts with every property.
bullets: What the client actually said is written down nowhere.
Prices, service charges and promises sit scattered across chat messages.
By the next day three properties look the same.

sections.heading: Thirty seconds of talking is enough.
steps: Record a short memo after the viewing, in the car. Just you, no conversation needed.
Parley writes the feedback in Dutch or English, in the form shown here.
You read it and send it on, or paste it into your CRM.

sections.heading: What it does and does not do.
bullets: Works on your phone, your laptop and in the browser.
It records the conversation with the client too, if you prefer that. Tell the client you are recording.
Asking prices, service charges and budgets come through exactly as you say them.

note.title: Saturday viewings, the Okafor family
note.summary: First we saw Lijsterstraat 14, asking price EUR 475,000. That one disappointed because of the north facing garden and the state of the window frames. Then Van Heemskerckkade 7, asking price EUR 525,000 with a service charge of EUR 185 a month. That one landed well for the light and the balcony, but the kitchen has to go.

items.t: Within a ten minute cycle of school.

items.m: The mortgage adviser confirmed EUR 560,000. Bidding up to 5 percent over is open for discussion.
Client estimates EUR 20,000. Agreed: get a quote.
Agreed: request the accounts and the maintenance plan.

items.t: Request the maintenance plan and the owners association minutes from the selling agent.
Book a second viewing at Van Heemskerckkade 7.
Find two more homes within budget with a south facing garden.

after: Send the feedback as an email to the seller or to your client.
Put the action items on your task list, with a date.
Ask your own notes later: who was looking for a south facing garden.

pilot.heading: Pilot for ten offices
pilot.text: Three months free. In return I ask for twenty minutes a month: what works and what does not.

title: Parley Notes for
insurance brokers
insurance.subtitle: You have the conversation. Parley writes the file note, in the form a reviewer can read cold.

sections.heading: The meeting is the easy part. The file is not.
lede: You have a good advice conversation at the client's table. Then you type it up in the evening.
bullets: The advice has to rest on the client profile and be motivated (Wft 4:23).
You keep the file for five years.
If a complaint reaches Kifid, that file is your evidence.

sections.heading: Record, read, paste.
steps: Start the recording and tell the client you are recording.
Parley writes the note in Dutch or English, in the form shown here.
You read it, adjust it and paste it into your advice software.

sections.heading: What it does and does not do.
bullets: Works on your phone, your laptop and in the browser.
No bot in the meeting. You record on your own device.
For life and income cover, Parley records only that the health questions were asked and answered, never the answers themselves.
Parley does not replace your advice software. The file stays yours.

note.title: Advice meeting, the Kramer family
note.summary: The client wants to top up income in case of disability and to reinsure the contents after the renovation. The recommendation is the income protection policy from insurer A, with a 90 day waiting period and an end age of 67, because the payout matches the fixed costs the client named. The client turns down the additional accident cover and will decide in the week of 13 October about the higher contents sum. Health questions were asked and answered.

items.b: Insurer A, income protection, EUR 212 a month.
items.m: 90 day wait, end age 67. Recommended: the payout covers the fixed costs the client named.

items.b: Insurer B, income protection, EUR 188 a month.
items.m: 180 day wait. Not recommended: six months without income.

items.b: Insurer C, contents, EUR 24 a month.
items.m: Sum insured EUR 95,000, which is before the renovation.

items.t: Client sends the last two annual accounts.
Request a contents quote with a sum insured of EUR 120,000.
Submit the income protection application before 20 October, start date 1 November.

groups.label: Open questions
items: Does the home office fall under contents or under business cover.
Whether the client still wants the accident cover later.

after: Send the summary to the client as an email.
Put the action items on your task list, with a date.
Ask your own notes later: which clients still owe documents.
